title: Bitcoin’s $100,000 dream slips away as $939 million crypto wipeout pushes traders toward $78,000
summary: Bitcoin registered an intraday low of $79,730 before recovering to around $82,000 as surging US wholesale inflation intensified a cryptocurrency selloff that triggered nearly $940 million in liquidations. This price action extended losses as stronger-than-expected inflation data raised concerns about another interest rate hike by the Federal Reserve.
